description: Upgrades an etcd cluster one member at a time: stop, replace binary, start, verify member health. Snapshot taken before upgrade. Full rollback via etcdctl snapshot restore (data loss window = writes since snapshot).

target_version.label: Target Version
target_version.description: Target etcd version (e.g. 3.5). Must be +1 minor.

members.label: etcd Members
members.description: List of {name, peer_url, client_url}. Optional for single-node deployments.

snapshot_s3_bucket.label: Snapshot S3 Bucket
snapshot_s3_bucket.description: Optional S3 bucket to upload snapshot for durable offsite storage

dry_run.label: Dry Run
dry_run.description: Run preflight checks only — no changes applied

rollback.description: etcdctl snapshot restore on all members. Canonical etcd rollback path. Data loss window: all writes after snapshot creation are lost. Rollback surfaces this data loss window clearly.
